messages:
ops-bot: PagerDuty: PROD_GATEWAY_SPIKE detected - elevated 502/504 across edge clusters. Severity: SEV2
alex: seeing a 3x jump in 502s across us-east-1. Dashboard shows 502 rate up at 18:02 UTC
ria: confirmed, looks like proxy -> upstream timeouts, also seeing missing spans in traces (sampling rate dropped to 0%)
devon: +1 missing traces. observability sampler hit budget and appears to have cut to 0% at the ingestion boundary
alex: any customer-facing errors? support triage?
samir: support reports intermittent timeouts for ~6 enterprise customers, one flagged as P1 due to stuck job retries
lina: @alex can you summarize customer impact/timeframe? need to alert account teams if > 10m
alex: impact: intermittent API errors for ~6 customers, latency spikes. ~18:00-18:10 UTC. not universal failures
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-29382. Runbook: gateway-5xx
ria: trying live debug: tailing gateway logs but traces missing. suspect trace headers dropped between edge and collector
devon: hypothesis: observability controller throttled sampling due to cardinality spike. collectors returned 0% sampling as stopgap
alex: we need stopgap visibility. plan: (1) temporary minimal 5xx-only logging at edge with request_id, status, upstream, (2) enable tiny sampling (1%) on a collector canary to get traces for correlation
samir: i'll push lightweight Lua/nginx patch to emit minimal logs for 5xx only. low overhead
lina: include request_id header capture: "req_id=$http_x_request_id" in the log format
samir: patch snippet to inject (canary):
```
map $status $is_5xx { ~^[45] 1; default 0; }
log_format minimal_5xx '$time_iso8601 req=$http_x_request_id status=$status upstream=$upstream_addr';
access_log /var/log/nginx/edge-5xx.log minimal_5xx if=$is_5xx;
```
devon: also plan sampler override on collector-canary: set OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY=0.01 on one replica to allow tiny sample through
ria: caution: changing collector env could trigger autoscaler restarts - proceed on canary only
alex: do both: logging first, then sampler on collector-canary to confirm spans come through
ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout of edge logging -> canary 2/10 at 18:08 UTC
samir: edge logging live on canary, tailing file now
samir: grep shows lines: `2026-11-18T18:09:12Z req=abc123 status=502 upstream=up-12`
ria: good. flipping sampler on collector-canary now
devon: updated env OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY=0.01, restarting collector-canary pod
devon: collector-canary received spans with those request_ids, span indicates upstream connect timeout
alex: preliminary root cause: upstream pool exhaustion causing timeouts under heavy tail for certain customer patterns
lina: mitigation steps: keep 5xx minimal logging global for 30m, keep collector-canary sampler at 1% for 15m to validate traces, scale upstream pools if errors persist
ria: will correlate request_id in logs -> spans -> upstream host to identify hot customers/paths
samir: CS has messaged affected accounts and provided retry/backoff guidance; one account escalated to SE team
ops-bot: PagerDuty: notify next on-call rotation - @devon (oncall) 18:30 UTC handoff reminder
alex: note for postmortem: include why sampler hit 0% (budget thresholds) and recommend adaptive-sampling adjustments for burst scenarios
devon: will draft postmortem after stabilization
lina: handing off to devon at 18:25, leaving now. @devon take ownership and keep logging + sampler in place until traces stable
devon: ack taking over. status: edge logging canary -> rolled to 6/10, collector-canary sampler live, error rate down ~40% and trending
ria: visibility improving; received spans correlated to request logs. still missing full traces but enough for root cause verification
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-29382 severity SEV2 -> monitoring. If errors stay below threshold for 15m, we will downgrade to SEV3
devon: will monitor 30m window, then rollback sampler and remove temporary logging if stable
alex: follow-ups: tracing budget re-eval, sampler override runbook, automated temporary logging toggle
lina: +1. also consider light-weight client-side retry fix for affected SDKs
samir: CS will update customers in 1h with remediation timeline
devon: handing full context to next oncall @ria for overnight monitoring; will sync with PM tomorrow
ria: ack. monitoring dashboards set, will escalate if we see regressions
ops-bot: Incident log updated: timeline and mitigations captured
alex: closing thread for now; will convert to postmortem doc if severity doesn't drop
